text:
liam: Planning a thermal soak + NIC firmware hotpatch for the 'rivet' GPU pool (az22). Window: Wed 23:30-02:30 UTC. Scope: kernel+NIC microcode + small driver bump. Goal: rolling soft-reboots with kv-cache warm reseed and minimal p99 impact.
nora: What percentage of fleet is rivet? who owns heavy tenants there?
liam: Rivet = ~9% of global GPU fleet. Heavy tenants: TenantX (dedicated), TenantY (training bursts). We'll exclude TenantX dedicated hosts from first wave and do targeted canary.

ash: Backfill plan? we recently preheated spot-standby nodes in burst-03, right?
liam: Yes, burst-03 preheated. Expected capacity dip per cohort ~7% for 30-50m. We'll stagger 15m between nodes to smooth traffic.

devops-bot: Preflight checks: node-health=ok, reserve>=10%? reserve=9%. Action: bump reserve or validate backfill.
liam: Manual bump executed, reserve now 13%. Autoscaler reported OK.

nora: Network note: az22 peers with az21 on shared transit. Prior window caused transient BGP route flaps when many pods rescheduled. Recommend limiting egress rehoming by using `egress-shim` for live ops.

ash: Canary proposal: 1) pick 2 non-prod rivet nodes, drain, apply updates, reboot, hold 20m. abort if p99 > 220ms or kv-miss > 6%.
liam: Agreed. Canary start 23:40 UTC. I'll tag logs `rivet:hotpatch`.

nora: Smoke test (runs every 3m during canary):
```bash
# quick generation to validate stream latency
python infra/tests/smoke_stream.py --model redwood-2x --region az22 --iters 5
```
We'll collect `traces/prefix` and compare hit-rates.

ash: kubectl drain/snippet (grace 300s):
```bash
kubectl drain node/rivet-021 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=300 --timeout=10m
```
After reboot: run `kubectl uncordon`.

finance-bot: Cost estimate for burst backfill ~ $2.1k (2.5h window). Approve?
liam: Approve. Flag finance for chargeback to infra ops.

oncall-bot: Rollback triggers configured: kv-cache-miss >= 5% sustained for 5m OR p99 >= 250ms for 4m OR error-rate > 0.7%. Automatic fallback route to eu-west2 set.
nora: Post-change telemetry: capture `/var/log/dmesg`, `nvidia-smi -q`, kernel version, and NIC firmware version. Push to s3 `s3://redwood-ops/maint/6572000000/`.

ash: KMS check: ensure nodes do not trigger HSM reconnects on reboot (we saw 30s delays last time). Add KMS-heartbeat pre/post.
liam: Will add KMS heartbeat check in runbook.

nora: Also ensure we throttle tenant Y training jobs via quota-controller during drain to avoid bulk reschedules.

ash: Canary abort plan: if breach -> mark cohort paused, run rollback job to previous driver, uncordon nodes, and escalate to oncall. devops-bot will run rollback after 2 approvals.

liam: Final checklist: runbook link -> https://wiki.redwood.dev/ops/rivet-hotpatch-6572000000 (will post 20m before start). Ops oncall = @ash, SE point = @nora, escalation = @liam.

nora: Posting customer comms: "Brief rolling maintenance in az22; some high-p99 workloads may see transient latency. No action required unless you're on dedicated hosts." Targeted email to TenantX SEs scheduled.

ash: :thumbsup: I'll run the canary and keep a live thread in #eng-infra during the window.

liam: deploy-bot: maintenance created -> id=maint-6572000000 owner=liam cohorts=[az22] backfill_pool=burst-03
